name: Call transcript signals
description: Pull yes or no signals out of a call transcript for the CRM.
use_when: On each call transcript, one question per CRM field, never a single big question.

asked_about_price.instructions: The prospect asked about price or cost

decision_maker_present.instructions: The person on the call can make or approve the decision

buying_signal.instructions: Strength of the buying signals in the call

follow_up_requested.instructions: The prospect asked for a follow up or more information
